Complete the following task: Download resumes.zip from owncloud on http://the-agent-company.com:8092/ under Documents > Human Resources Team > resumes folder and categorize them locally based on the candidates' YOE. You should place them into one of the following folders under /workspace directory:

- early-career
- mid-level
- senior
- unsure

Where early-career folder stores all resumes of candidates who have less than one year of full-time working experience; mid-level folder stores all resumes of those who have less than 5 years of full-time working experience; and senior folder for those who work for at least 5 years. Keep the resumes in their original PDF format.

A few tips:

* Do your best judgement based on the resume itself. Don't try to look up the candidates' LinkedIn profiles.
* If you are not sure about the YOE, put the resume in the unsure folder.
* For simplicity, assume today is 12/01/2024.

IMPORTANT: here is our services urls and credentials, use the only if you are required to.
## GitLab
* service url: http://the-agent-company.com:8929
* root email: `root@local`
* root password: `theagentcompany`

## ownCloud

* username: `theagentcompany`
* password: `theagentcompany`

## Plane

* API_KEY:`plane_api_83f868352c6f490aba59b869ffdae1cf`

## RocketChat

* email: `theagentcompany`
* password: `theagentcompany`
